description: This file defines the StringBody class, a model representing string-based HTTP bodies with content type and encoding options, including methods for creation, comparison, and byte retrieval.

classes.name: StringBody
classes.description: Represents an HTTP body with string content, supporting content type, charset, substring flag, and raw byte access.

methods.name: StringBody
methods.description: Constructs a StringBody with specified value, charset, or content type.

methods.name: exact
methods.description: Creates a StringBody with exact string content, optionally with charset or content type.

methods.name: subString
methods.description: Creates a StringBody marked as a substring, with optional charset or content type.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the string value of the body.

methods.name: getRawBytes
methods.description: Returns the raw byte array of the body content.

methods.name: isSubString
methods.description: Indicates if the body is a substring.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string value of the body.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on value, raw bytes, and substring flag.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on content and raw bytes.
